dct_description_sm: Alternate title: La Nouvelle Angleterre en 4 feuilles.

Alternate title: La Nouvelle Angleterre en 4 feuilles. Hand colored. Prime meridian: London and Ferro. Relief shown pictorially. From the author's Atlas amériquain septentrional. 1778-[92] Includes compilation data and insets of "Plan de Boston," ca. 1:18,000 and "A plan of Boston Harbor from an accurate survey," ca. 1:150,000. No. "11" on verso, upper left corner of top sheet. Scale ca. 1:440,000. LC Maps of North America, 1750-1789, 802 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2

dct_title_s: A map of the most inhabited part of New England, containing the provinces of Massachusets Bay and New Hampshire with the colonies of Conecticut and Rhode Island divided into counties and townships, the w[h]ole composed from actual surveys and its situation adjusted by astronomical observations. After the original by M. Le Rouge
